_comment: GAZP staged calibration on 2026-11-04. ATRPeriod=14 and MaxHoldBars=0 stay fixed; MaxRetestBars is a small separate grid around the current literal 12. The best training candidate had zero intermediate validation trades; three rolling OOS folds pooled PF 0.530 on 22 trades. No new parameter set was promoted. The last three months were excluded from selection; prior runs have already viewed them, so they are not a pristine holdout for future calibration.
